title: 'Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori' Announces Additional Cast Pair, Second Cour for Fall 2026
content:
The official website of the Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori ( Red River ) television anime revealed two additional cast members on Monday. The anime series adapting Chie Shinohara 's adventure fantasy manga is currently airing with a second cour scheduled to begin on September 29 at 1:35 a.m. on NTV's AnichU programming block, followed by BS-NTV.

Voice actors Souma Saitou ( Shuumatsu no Walküre ) and Shun Horie ( Yuusha-kei ni Shosu ) are joining the cast as User Ramses and Juda Haspaslupi, respectively.

Kousuke Kobayashi ( Hyakuren no Haou to Seiyaku no Valkyria ) is helming the anime at Tatsunoko Production . Yoriko Tomita ( Nige Jouzu no Wakagimi ) is handling the series composition and Kenji Fujisaki ( Blood Lad ) is designing the characters. Yoshihisa Hirano ( Hunter x Hunter (2011) ) is composing the music.

Shinohara serialized the manga in Sho-Comi from January 1995 to January 2002. Shogakukan published the 28th and final volume in July 2002. The manga has a cumulative 20 million copies of its volumes in circulation, including digital editions.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in February 2004 and published all 28 volumes from June 2004 to January 2010.

News Submitted by NokkiMal

title: '100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You' Season 3 Casts Rie Kugimiya
content:
The official website for third television anime season based on Rikito Nakamura and Yukiko Nozawa 's The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You ( Kimi no koto ga Dai Dai Dai Dai Daisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo ) manga announced on Monday that Rie Kugimiya has joined the anime's cast as Yaku Yakuzen, Kusuri's grandmother and Rentarō's newest girlfriend. The character debuted in the third season's eighth episode on Sunday.

Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Aijo Rentaro tried and tried again, but after asking a hundred girls out on a date, he was rejected every single time. In desperation, he prays for guidance...only to be told by a god that his rejections were due to some cosmic error! Now the god is going to set things right by making sure that Aijo gets one hundred dates. Except, as things often do with gods, the dates come with a catch: one hundred girls are destined to be Aijo's soulmate, and unless he returns their feelings each and every time, they'll die in horrible accidents! Sure enough, girls start confessing their love to Aijo left and right. But how is he supposed to choose?! He doesn't want to kill anyone! When he looks at each potential soulmate, it feels like a bolt of lightning. Can someone really love a hundred other people? This hilarious romantic comedy takes the harem concept to a wild extreme!

The new season also stars Kaori Ishihara as Chiyo Iin, Ayana Taketatsu as Nadi, Hana Tamegai as Yamame Yasashiki, and Aoi Koga as Momiji Momi.

Hikaru Sato ( Dropkick on My Devil! ) is returning from directing the first two seasons at Bibury Animation Studio . Takashi Aoshima ( Uzaki-chan Wants to Hang Out! ) is back in charge of the series scripts. Akane Yano ( Bottom-tier Character Tomozaki ) continues to design the characters. Shūhei Mutsuki , Shunsuke Takizawa (Trytonelabo), and eba are also returning to compose the music at Lantis .

The Rentaro Family perform the opening "Daisuki ♡Zutto Eien ni ♡" (I Love You ♡Always and Forever ♡).

The season premiered on the Tokyo MX channel on July 5 at 10:30 p.m. (9:30 a.m. EDT), and it will also run on Sun TV and BS11 .

title: One Piece May Have Just Confirmed the Elbaph Arc Is Ending Very Soon
content:
The One Piece manga continues its development despite having more breaks recently than ever. The manga is currently featuring an epic battle with Imu, the King of the World, who intends to bring Elbaph to its knees and is currently engaged in a battle against the warriors of Elbaph, with Luffy also joining the fight. However, Imu consistently overwhelms everyone, and recent chapters have also seen Imu nearly defeat Luffy. Had it not been for Gaban’s intervention, Luffy would have met his defeat and possibly died as well. However, it seems that Gaban might be the one who will actually die protecting Elbaph and Luffy.

However, the latest chapter, 1191, seems to have refrained from that possibility and is instead setting up the arc to end soon in a situation similar to what fans have already seen in the series. As Hajrudinn also joins the fight in the latest chapter, Gaban instructs Luffy to take his crew and get out of Elbaph. Even Hajrudinn gets overwhelmed, prompting Gaban to make it a priority for Luffy and his crew to leave the island, as he doesn’t see anyone getting out of this fight alive. Gaban’s insistence that Luffy and the Straw Hats leave the island could mean that the Elbaph arc will end with the Straw Hats leaving soon , as the warriors sacrifice themselves for Luffy to reach his potential and face Imu in the final battle of One Piece .

One Piece Might Enter a Time Skip as the Elbaph Arc Nears Its End

The recent chapters have made it very clear that despite Luffy’s overpowered Gear 5 transformation, he is still no match for the King of the World , the supposed final villain of the series. Luffy has to emerge as strong as Joyboy, and as Imu states, Luffy is nowhere near that level. This means that the captain of the Straw Hats will still need a lot more time before he can become as strong as Joyboy and actually challenge Imu. Therefore, Scopper Gaban’s insistence on Luffy and the Straw Hats leaving the island might become the priority, with Loki, Hajrudin, and Gaban paving the way.

This might become even clearer after seeing the outcome of Zoro and Sanji’s fights against their current opponents, Sommers and Killingham. Gaban has only now laid out the instructions for how they can actually land hits on these seemingly invincible villains, and with Sanji not even having Conqueror’s Haki, it seems impossible for them to actually defeat these villains without precise execution. All of this hints that, at their current capabilities, the Straw Hats are not strong enough to take on these new villains and will require training to emerge stronger.

This could indeed lead to the Straw Hats prioritizing leaving Elbaph and then training these new techniques, which could be featured in a time skip as well, given that it isn’t something the Straw Hats could master overnight. This would make perfect sense as a way for the Straw Hats to receive the boost they need to emerge stronger, and nothing could justify it more than a time skip, which could feature Imu gaining even more power in the meantime and ultimately propelling the final One Piece battle foretold by the Harley prophecy, with Luffy emerging as the true Joyboy with the Haki that Imu fears. In any case, One Piece is heading into its final stage, and since Elbaph isn’t the arc to feature the final battle, it means that this arc will subdue this conflict soon after the final villain showcases his power, giving the heroes the final boost they need to emerge stronger for the final war of One Piece .

title: Crossed Hearts Launches Studio Hearts Imprint, New Licenses
content:
California-based global English publisher Crossed Hearts announced on Sunday at the Anime NYC convention that it is launching an in-house imprint Studio Hearts and presenting several new licenses.

Studio Hearts will launch with three original titles: Doomsday Requiem With You , Chiaroscuro , and Soul Guiders.

The publisher also announced the following licenses:

• Welcome to the Rose Manor (manhwa)

• Flirting with the Villain's Dad (manhwa)

• The Two of Them Can't Be Mobs (manga, COMISMA)

• Love Beyond the Final Boss: The Hero's Party's Quest for Love (manga, COMISMA)

• Emma and the Eyes that Bid Farewell (manga, COMISMA)

• Where Sea Meets Shore (manga, Creator Original)

• The Devil in Me (Thai comic, Glam Beat imprint)

• Ink Soaked into Ashen Paper (Korean novel, Glam Beat imprint)

• Fairy Trap (Korean novel, Blush Club imprint)

• Addicted to You (manga, Blush Club imprint)

Crossed Hearts also announced a partnership with Thai girls-love publisher Lily House to release titles in English.

Kadokawa 's BookWalker Global store announced earlier this month that it is adding Cross Hearts' titles to its catalogue.

ANN's coverage of Anime NYC 2026 is sponsored by Yen Press. Whether it's light novels, manga, or manhwa, Yen Press has everything you might want to add to your reading shelves! Visit Booth #1701 or YenPress.com for more information!

title: Yūki Kodama's Agent Jupiter Manga Ends
content:
Comic Days published the final chapter of Yūki Kodama 's Agent Jupiter manga on August 20.

The story follows the powerful agent Jupiter, who retires in the parallel world A after completing his quest of revenge for his sister in parallel world B. While he intended to hide his power and assume a civilian life, a young girl appears in his life and turns his plans upside down.

Kodama launched the series in Kodansha 's Morning two magazine in February 2025. Kodansha shipped the third compiled book volume on June 23.

Kodama launched The World of Summoning ( Shо̄kan Suru Sekai ) manga in Kodansha 's Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine in February 2022, and ended it in May 2023. Kodansha published the manga's third and final compiled book volume in July 2023. The manga had a worldwide simultaneous release in English and French.

Kodama launched the vampire comedy manga Blood Lad in Kadokawa 's Young Ace magazine in 2009, and ended it in September 2016. The manga's 17th and final compiled volume shipped in Japan in December 2016. Yen Press publishes the manga and the spinoff manga Bloody Brat in North America. The manga inspired a 10-episode television anime, which premiered in 2013. Viz Media streamed the series on Hulu as it aired in Japan, and released it on DVD and Blu-ray Disc in September 2014.

Kodama and Yukinori Kitajima launched the manga Hamatora in Shueisha 's Weekly Young Jump in November 2013, and ended it in December 2014. Shueisha shipped the third and final compiled volume of the manga in February 2015. The manga was part of a multimedia project that also featured two anime series, two stage plays , and a Nintendo 3DS game by FuRyu . Crunchyroll streamed both anime series as they aired in Japan. Sentai Filmworks released both anime seasons on Blu-ray Disc and DVD in 2015 and 2016.

Kodama launched the Demon Tune series in Jump SQ. in January 2018, and the manga moved to Shonen Jump+ in December 2018. The series ended in May 2019.

title: Manga Up! Global Adds Unwinding with the Aloof Girl at the Standing Bar Manga
content:
Manga UP! Global added author Sorinokoshi and artist Taichi Ōkubo 's Unwinding with the Aloof Girl at the Standing Bar manga in English on Saturday.

Manga UP! describes the manga's story:

Late-twenties office worker Seiya Tonami has made it a routine to get solo drinks every Friday at his favorite standing bar. But when he rescues a college girl from unwanted harassment at said bar, he gains a new drinking companion. Between everyday banter and light venting, there's now someone by his side to share a laugh with. Cozy up to a heartwarming and slightly tipsy romantic comedy set in a standing bar, where Friday nights become something to look forward to.

The manga launched on Square Enix 's Manga UP! website in August 2025. The company shipped the second compiled volume of the manga on June 5.

title: Ignatz Awards Nominate Box Garden Beetle Manga for Outstanding Collection
content:
Glacier Bay Books describes its story:

Unfurling fields of morning glories and buttony polka dots. Wormholes of childhood memories and cabinets of magical curiosities. Balletic bands of laughter and creeping stippled shadows.

Seirinkogeisha published the manga short story collection in Japan in 2004.

Glacier Bay Books first announced its release of the manga in May 2025. It launched a Kickstarter crowdfunding campaign for it along with several other titles in August 2025. The company announced in April that printing was nearly finished, before publishing the collection in English in May.

Ryan Holmberg translated the collection. Tim Sun did the lettering, and Emuh Ruh and Ryan Holmberg were the editors.

The Ignatz Awards, which are named after the character in George Herriman's seminal comic Krazy Kat , recognize "outstanding achievement in comics and cartooning." A jury of cartoonists create a ballot every year, and then the attendees of Small Press Expo vote on the nominees.

The 2024 Ignatz Awards nominated Offshore Lightning , a collection of short manga by author Nazuna Saitō , for "Outstanding Collection."

Glacier Bay Books ' Glaeolia 2 collection of indie manga won the award for the "Outstanding Anthology" category in the 2021 Ignatz Awards.

title: RIDI to Shut Down Japanese Short-Form Live-Action Platform Kanta
content:
Korean content platform RIDI announced on Thursday that it will shut down Kanta, its short-form live-action platform in Japan, as part of a restructuring of its business portfolio.

RIDI launched Kanta in Japan in July 2025, offering short-form dramas based on Korean content. The company said it decided to discontinue the service to focus its resources on its fan community platform business built around comics, webtoons, and web novels amid the rapidly changing global market.

RIDI plans to use the production expertise and user data accumulated through Kanta to expand its intellectual properties and strengthen its related businesses. The company will also explore new ways to utilize the IP assets acquired through the service.

title: Bleach Makes Anime History With Its Latest Episode After Pulling Off Major Changes
content:
Bleach finally returned years after its original run ended to adapt the Thousand-Year Blood War , a story the original anime never depicted. Since summer 2026, the final part of this arc has been airing, and as expected, the series’ final stretch has continued to exceed expectations and blow fans’ minds. In just five episodes, the final stretch of the anime has featured not one but two Bankai that had been concealed for decades , while also introducing a major retcon involving a prominent character. However, there is no doubt that the series’ main character, Ichigo, has been stealing the show in his final confrontation against Yhwach.

However, unlike his battle against Aizen, Ichigo isn’t alone, as Orihime has been following him closely and actively participating in the fight by helping Ichigo heal and shielding him from attacks. The original manga did not feature her role to this extent, making her involvement one of the anime’s notable changes. Meanwhile, the latest episode also features changes to Ichigo’s new Bankai that were not present in the original manga, giving him a new look and expanding its scope. As a result, Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 45, titled “Defend You,” debuted with a perfect 10/10 score on IMDb, which it maintained until it reached 21,000 ratings, making anime history.

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Makes Anime History With a Perfect IMDb Score

Anime episodes debuting with a perfect 10/10 on IMDb are a feat only a few have achieved, with the most recent notable example being an episode from Re:Zero ‘s fourth season, which maintained its 10/10 score with several thousand ratings. However, Bleach has exceeded that achievement with a perfect rating across more than 20,000 ratings. Currently, the episode is rated 9.9 with 27,000 ratings as of this writing. The significance behind Bleach ‘s latest episode achieving such a high rating goes far beyond what the number represents. Tite Kubo, the creator of Bleach , has repeatedly expressed that he wanted to explore even more in the manga’s final moments. However, various constraints forced him to end the series much faster than he intended.

Thus, with the emergence of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War , Tite Kubo became fully involved in the anime’s production, which led to several major changes. The latest changes involving Orihime have helped address one of the biggest issues in shonen anime: failing to feature compelling female characters. With Orihime’s involvement going to such an extent and her constantly pushing herself, the series has effectively portrayed the notion of love and how it can push individuals to go beyond limits they never imagined.

Meanwhile, without a doubt, the major change was Ichigo’s new Bankai debuting with a completely new look, depicted with Blood Chains, which fans have come to see as a potential tease for the one-shot Hell arc of the franchise. Fans of the series naturally embraced these changes, reflecting that when a creator’s true vision is brought to life, the results can be extraordinary. Bleach having its final arc animated has been one of the biggest wishes of its fans, and seeing it finally come true has fulfilled the fandom, highlighting that when fans get what they want and even more, an anime can make history.

Meanwhile, without a doubt, the major change was Ichigo’s new Bankai debuting with a completely new look, depicted with Blood Chains, which fans have come to see as a potential tease for the one-shot Hell arc of the franchise. Fans of the series naturally embraced these changes, reflecting that when a creator’s true vision is brought to life, the results can be extraordinary. Bleach having its final arc animated has been one of the biggest wishes of its fans, and seeing it finally come true has fulfilled the fandom, highlighting that when fans get what they want and even more, an anime can make history.

title: Kakao Games Partners With The Grimm Entertainment to Develop Games Based on Webtoons
content:
Kakao Games announced on August 4 that it has agreed to work with webtoon studio The Grimm Entertainment to develop and publish games based on its popular comic and webtoon intellectual properties.

Founded by webtoon artist Taejun Pak , The Grimm Entertainment owns several popular IPs, including Manager Kim , (also known as Agent Kim: Reactivated ) and Lookism , which have gained popularity in both South Korea and international markets. Pak and The Grimm Entertainment are also known for the Viral Hit webtoon, which has inspired both an anime and a Japanese live-action adaptation.

Under the agreement, Kakao Games will adapt The Grimm Entertainment's webtoon IPs into games, expanding its popular titles into new forms of entertainment.

Kakao Games CEO Si-woo Lee said, “We expect our partnership with The Grimm Entertainment, which has powerful IP and a strong fanbase, to bring new experiences to players. We will work closely together to create games that can attract significant interest in global markets.”

The Grimm Entertainment CEO Hyung-soo Ahn said, “We are pleased to work with Kakao Games, which has extensive experience in game services. By combining our IP and webtoons with games, we hope to create another successful example of adapting a single IP across multiple forms of media.”
